description: This file implements the feature for creating an article, including data models, validation, command handling, and database interactions within the 'Conduit' application.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data model representing the properties needed to create an article, including title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ArticleData, ensuring required fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Represents the create article command, encapsulating the article data, used with MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the Command, applying validation to the nested Article data.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of an article, including database operations to save the article, tags, and associate them.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of adding a new article, managing tags, and storing them in the database, then returning an ArticleEnvelope.
